Japanese owner's safe and stable Italian
Jan 2026 • Couples
It is an Italian restaurant owned by Japanese. Pizza is famous, but pasta is also available.
In Japan, I think Pietro in Hakata is the closest to Pietro in terms of taste, but I think many people don’t know the taste of Pietro in Hakata, so it’s even higher than Caprichosa from a Tokyo perspective.

Taste of security and stability, customer service. Beer is also available with original IPAs, and wine is usually delicious.

The space is also wonderful and nice.
